lines: IT'S MY 1,000TH MEME SUBMISSION! UPVOTE THIS MEME TO RAISE AWARENESS!
INTROVERTS UNITE! SEPARATELY...IN YOUR OWN HOMES...ALONE.
SAVE THE FORESTS! EAT MORE BEAVERS!
JUSTIN BIEBER FINALLY GOT ARRESTED. LET THE MEMES BEGIN
ME WHEN MY MEME GETS ONE VIEW
QUICK! LIKE THIS MEME FOR NO REASON!!
THAT MOMENT WHEN YOU FIND OUT THAT THE PERSON THAT YOU HATE IS MOVING!!!!!

meaning.meaning_en: This meme depicts a character screaming with intense enthusiasm while holding a torch, representing a loud, passionate, or unhinged declaration. The text boxes are used to write a slogan, a rallying cry, or a chaotic statement that the character is shouting at the top of their lungs.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieses Meme zeigt eine Figur, die mit intensiver Begeisterung schreit und eine Fackel hält, was eine laute, leidenschaftliche oder verrückte Erklärung darstellt. Die Textfelder werden verwendet, um ein Motto, einen Aufruf oder eine chaotische Aussage zu schreiben, die die Figur mit voller Kehle brüllt.
situations_en: I am SO done with this project, I need to scream!
Let's go get tacos, I am starving!
I finally passed the exam, I am so happy!
We need to clean the house, I am ready!
I love this song, I could listen to it forever!
